answer_1.quote: Long-form question answering, an emerging research area within QA, requires systems to generate long and complex answers to questions by leveraging large language models and evidence document retrievers.

answer_2.quote: We curate a suite of 12 automatic metrics and measure how they correlate to human judgments of both "overall quality" and two fine-grained aspects (coherence and faithfulness).

answer_3.quote: We fine-tune a smaller-scale pretrained language model (176M Longformer-Base model) and rely on OpenAI's API to fine-tune bigger pretrained language model (6B GPT3 text-curie-001 model). Given a prompt consisting of question q, answer a1 and answer a2, the model is fine-tuned to output the label Answer1 or Answer2.

answer_4.quote: We hire domain experts in seven different fields ... to perform the same answer preference task and additionally provide detailed justifications as to why they chose a particular answer. The experts were asked to choose which of the answers is better (overall preference), indicate whether the decision was difficult to make, and justify their choice in a free-form paragraph.
answer_4.guideline: Experts were instructed to select the better answer overall, note difficulty, and provide a free-form justification covering various answer properties.
